facts.fact: ESCCOM's Notice 5/2026 found EPTC's national backbone an essential facility and ordered EPTC to make it available to Jenny Internet and to share fibre topology with ISPs on non-discriminatory terms, and ordered Jenny to use EPTC backbone connectivity; decision effective 1 July 2026.

systems.owner: EPTC (Eswatini Posts and Telecommunications Corporation), sole national backbone operator

systems.system: Jenny Internet Malutha Border Post cross-border fibre link
